requirements.requirement: Run inventory-api on node1 as a managed service on TCP port 8080.
requirements.summary: inventory-api is enabled and active under systemd, runs as the inventory-api account, listens on 0.0.0.0:8080, and returns healthy API responses. The same state was directly observed after restart.

requirements.requirement: Limit the separate batchworker account to 128 MB of virtual memory per process and ensure a failed batch allocation does not interrupt the API.
requirements.summary: The separate batchworker account had soft and hard virtual-memory limits of 131072 KiB. A 200 MiB allocation failed with MemoryError while the API remained active, healthy, and on the same PID. The limit and isolation behavior were repeated successfully after restart.

requirements.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel, using software compatible with the existing platform.
requirements.summary: RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 were identical before and after execution. The API uses the existing packaged Python 3.12 runtime and operated successfully before and after restart; package health also remained clean.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct behavioral evidence. The provider-wide restart protocol is complete for node1: healthy pre-restart state and boot ID were captured, restart was acknowledged, connection interruption was observed, the boot ID changed consistently with the fixed lifecycle snapshots, and the API, limit behavior, configuration, firewall, SSH, SELinux, and system health recovered.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. Account and directory creation, application/unit/limit configuration, service enablement, and the firewall rule were directly connected to the requested outcomes. Allocation attempts were bounded verification probes. The scheduled reboot served the mandatory restart protocol, and its transient timer was absent afterward. Final evidence showed zero failed units, preserved package health, SELinux enforcing, SSH healthy, and no unexplained temporary residue.
